page_title: BAR 4-3 RMA | Barcelona v Real Madrid 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' The goal by Barcelona is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
90+6' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Barcelona players aren’t happy.

90+5' Lovely run from Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) who weaves his way through the defence and takes a shot from the edge of the box that goes inside the right post! What an amazing goal ladies and gentlemen!
90+5' Dangerous play by Victor Munoz (Real Madrid). Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+2' There's an opportunity for Luka Modric (Real Madrid) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

90+2' The ball is laid off to Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Wojciech Szczesny to make a decent save. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
90+1' Gavi (Barcelona) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Victor Munoz (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
89' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gavi (Barcelona) replacing Ferran Torres.
88' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Victor Munoz.
87' Pedri (Barcelona) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
84' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Lucas Vazquez is replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
83' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Barcelona! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Alejandro Hernandez and both teams have no complaints.
82' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Barcelona! Let's see what he decides.
80' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
80' That looked a certain handball by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
80' Pedri (Barcelona) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

80' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Thibaut Courtois is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
78' The substitution has been made. Hector Fort has replaced Eric Garcia (Barcelona).
77' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) will be replaced by Fermin Lopez.
76' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
75' Raphinha (Barcelona) has a big opportunity! He finds some space for a shot inside the penalty box after collecting a lofted pass and sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar.
72' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Thibaut Courtois.

70' 4 - 3 Goal! Vinicius Junior displays great vision and sends a pass to Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 4:3.
66' Thibaut Courtois leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Raphinha (Barcelona).
66' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
65' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

65' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
61' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sprays a pass out to Kylian Mbappe, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
60' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raphinha (Barcelona).
59' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
57' Here is a change. Gerard Martin is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
57' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) will be replaced by Andreas Christensen.
56' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
54' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) will miss the next game.
54' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
54' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the right post.
53' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
52' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
51' The attendance is 50318.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
49' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
47' The linesman raises his flag. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.
46' The game is over for Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid). Luka Modric comes on for the second half.
46' Carlo Ancelotti makes a switch. Brahim Diaz is coming on in place of Arda Guler (Real Madrid) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+8' A goal, which was scored by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), was disallowed due to offside.
45+8' The ball is cleared after Ferran Torres (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45+6' Raphinha (Barcelona) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+5' Raphinha (Barcelona) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45+3' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+2' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 4 - 2 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Ferran Torres. The score is 4:2.
44' Although Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) is just on the bench, Alejandro Hernandez has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
44' The Real Madrid players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Alejandro Hernandez. NO PENALTY!
44' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Real Madrid as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
43' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona). Alejandro Hernandez saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty kick to Real Madrid!!
42' Lamine Yamal picks out Raphinha (Barcelona) with a lofted pass into the centre of the box, but his header rises just over the crossbar.
38' The rebound finds Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
37' Raphinha (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
36' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
36' The referee is firm and issues Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) a deserved yellow card.
34' 3 - 2 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) is teed up on the edge of the box by Pedri, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 3:2.
32' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the left post. Ferran Torres provided an assist for the goal.
30' The free kick is taken by Dani Olmo (Barcelona), but ball is cleared.
29' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
27' Raphinha (Barcelona) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
26' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.

26' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for an infringement. Barcelona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
24' The ball is laid off to Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Thibaut Courtois to make a decent save.
24' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.
24' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
24' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
19' 1 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 1:2.
19' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

19' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Thibaut Courtois is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
18' The corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) is cleared away by the defence.

18' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the right post is saved by Thibaut Courtois. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
17' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
16' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Alejandro Hernandez to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Real Madrid players can finally celebrate.
15' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Real Madrid players aren’t happy.

14' 0 - 2 Goal! Vinicius Junior finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the right side of the goal. Fantasy football! 0:2.
13' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
12' The resulting corner from Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is cleared.
11' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
11' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
10' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Hernandez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
8' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

8' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Thibaut Courtois comes off the line to clear the ball away. Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Wojciech Szczesny gets a hand on the penalty from Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
5' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
5' Referee Alejandro Hernandez is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Real Madrid!
4' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Real Madrid, he's going to review using VAR.
4' Wojciech Szczesny (Barcelona) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Penalty awarded! Real Madrid will take a penalty kick.
1' The free kick from long range, taken by Barcelona, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
1' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Barcelona.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Real Madrid will take the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez is the one to supervise the game today.
